raw_text: Chinese Influence Operation Targets Taiwan Election with Deepfakes, Fake Polls. Taiwan's Investigation Bureau has identified a large-scale Chinese influence operation aimed at disrupting the January 13 presidential election. The campaign uses AI-generated deepfake videos of candidates, fabricated opinion polls, and coordinated social media amplification through Spamouflage-linked accounts. Officials say the operation promotes KMT candidates while spreading fear narratives about DPP cross-strait policies triggering armed conflict with Beijing.
